title: Forest department investigated a reported leopard sighting
description: PTI reported that a forest department team responded to a call about an alleged campus sighting.

title: Two leopard sightings reported to the institute
description: Hindustan Times quoted IIT Bombay’s director describing two reports within 24 hours and notification of forest officials.

title: BNHS campus biodiversity audit
description: The audit recorded signs consistent with occasional leopard visits and documented other campus wildlife, including reptiles and birds.
